en: Hello {person}, we issued {qty} {ppe} on {date}. Please wear it every day for the work it is made for, and tell me when it is worn out.
mt: Halo, kami mengeluarkan {qty} {ppe} pada {date} Tolong pakai setiap hari untuk pekerjaan itu dibuat, dan memberitahu saya ketika itu dipakai.

en: The machine is {col:machines.age} years old with a planned life of {col:machines.life_years} years. Its value now is {col:machines.value_now}. The age check shows: {col:machines.state}.
mt: Mesin {col:machines.age} tahun dengan jangka waktu {col:machines.life_years} tahun. nilainya sekarang adalah {col:machines.value_now}.

en: The diesel price used is the average price paid on your fuel purchases. Every dip of the tank is compared with the stock in the books and a difference of more than {set:fuel_loss} is checked.
mt: Harga diesel yang digunakan adalah harga rata-rata yang dibayarkan untuk pembelian bahan bakar Anda.

en: Permanent staff pay is {col:payroll.perm_pay}, seasonal workers pay is {col:payroll.seasonal_pay} and piece-rate pay is {col:payroll.piece_pay}. Allowances and bonuses are {col:payroll.allowances}. The total pay is {col:payroll.pay_total}.
mt: Gaji staf tetap adalah {col:payroll.perm_pay}, gaji pekerja musiman adalah {col:payroll.seasonal_pay} dan gaji potongan adalah {col:payroll.piece_pay}.

en: Employer costs are {col:payroll.oncost_amt}, so the labour cost of the month is {col:payroll.labour_cost} for {col:payroll.hours} hours. The budget was {col:payroll.budget} and the check shows: {col:payroll.state}.
mt: Biaya majikan adalah {col:payroll.oncost_amt}, jadi biaya tenaga kerja bulan adalah {col:payroll.labour_cost} untuk {col:payroll.hours} jam.

en: During the contract the picker delivered {col:workers.piece_kg} kilograms of accepted fruit and vegetables. The piece-rate pay is {col:workers.piece_pay}.
mt: Selama kontrak pemetik memberikan {col:workers.piece_kg} kilogram buah-buahan dan sayuran yang diterima.

en: Time work on other days was paid {col:workers.pay}. The total pay is {col:workers.total_pay} for {col:workers.hours} hours.
mt: Waktu kerja pada hari-hari lain dibayar {col:workers.pay}.

en: The certificate was issued on {col:train.issued} and is valid for {col:train.valid_months} months. It ends on {col:train.expires}, which is in {col:train.days_left} days.
mt: Sertifikat ini dikeluarkan pada {col:train.issued} dan berlaku selama {col:train.valid_months} bulan.

en: The farm work of the month needs {col:labourneed.hours_needed} hours, which is {col:labourneed.fte} full-time workers. We have {col:labourneed.perm_workers} permanent staff, so we need {col:labourneed.seasonal_needed} seasonal workers.
mt: Pekerjaan pertanian bulan ini membutuhkan {col:labourneed.hours_needed} jam, yang merupakan {col:labourneed.fte} pekerja penuh waktu.

en: We have {col:labourneed.seasonal_hired} seasonal workers on contract, so {col:labourneed.gap} workers are still short. The check shows: {col:labourneed.state}.
mt: Kita memiliki {col:labourneed.seasonal_hired} pekerja musiman dengan kontrak, jadi {col:labourneed.gap} pekerja masih kekurangan.

en: The action check shows: {col:safety.state}. The record was closed on {col:safety.closed_on}.
mt: Pemeriksaan tindakan menunjukkan: {col:safety.state}.

mt: Halo {contact}, terima kasih atas pembayaran {amount} yang diterima pada {date} untuk faktur {invoice}.

en: Hello {contact}, contract {contract}: {delivered} t delivered of {contract_t} t, {left} t left, window ends {win_end}. Our forecast shows a shortfall of {shortfall} t. Can we agree a plan?
